title: Low-income Parents who Sell Flats Co-owned with Children so Children Can Buy Flats in Their Own Names
what_it_is: Low-income Parents who Sell Flats Co-owned with Children so Children Can Buy Flats in Their Own Names

sections.label: Parents co-owning HDB flats
sections.summary: Parents co-owning HDB flats with children can right-size to a smaller unit, and HDB may extend a housing loan case-by-case if proceeds are insufficient.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: For parents who co-own their HDB flats with their children and wish to purchase another flat when the children move out, they can consider right-sizing to a smaller unit that is within their budget.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This may be more sustainable in the long term, compared to having their children service both the mortgage on their parents' flat as well as their own home.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, in the circumstance where the sales proceeds are not sufficient even for a right-sized unit, then HDB would be prepared to exercise flexibility and extend a housing loan to the parents on a case-by-case basis.
